assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a precise 3 columns x 2 rows animation pose sheet, six equally sized square cells, on transparent background. This is an animation reference for the EXACT attached cream plush star messenger. Keep the same body silhouette, curled top tip, plum eyes and tiny smile, short torso, little feet, lilac scarf, warm pearly texture and lighting. Same front camera, same character size, same face landmarks and body position in EVERY cell. Do not redesign the character. Change only the short rounded paws and envelope positioning. Paws are tiny smooth bean/oval mittens organically joined to the upper torso just below the scarf: NO fingers, NO thumb, NO long arms, no disconnected parts. It has exactly two paws in every cell. All six poses should be anatomical drawings of one continuous gesture: Top left: original holding envelope against chest. Top middle: both attached paws begin lifting the envelope together toward viewer, envelope slightly higher and less tilted. Top right: both paws hold envelope out toward viewer, envelope about 10 percent larger, just below chin, connected short forearms still attached to torso; warm offering gesture. Bottom left: the envelope has been taken away, both round paws still held forward in the same offering position, palms gently opening sideways as a unified body gesture, clean cream torso visible. Bottom middle: both empty round paws halfway lowering back down toward torso. Bottom right: both tiny empty rounded paws at rest beside belly, short seamless connections at sides under scarf; no letter. Keep head, eyes, smile, scarf, legs, lighting and proportions identical throughout. No labels, no text, no borders, no extra stars or effects, no floor or shadow, genuine transparent alpha.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Extract and complete ONLY the ivory envelope held by the attached star character. Output one isolated envelope prop on transparent alpha, no character, no paws, no scarf, no extra items, no shadow. Preserve the exact original envelope: soft warm ivory textured paper, closed triangular flap, round dark mulberry/plum wax seal with a cream four-pointed star. Reconstruct the small areas hidden by the paws as continuous straight paper edges. Same front facing flat envelope, original clockwise tilt around 9 degrees, thin paper thickness, soft warm light from upper left. Rectangular wide envelope ratio approximately 1.4 to 1, no text. Center it with generous transparent margin and retain the complete four corners. It must look exactly like the attached reference envelope, not a redesigned icon.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact attached image into a clean animation background plate. Remove ONLY the envelope and BOTH small paws holding it. Reconstruct the cream torso behind them and the small parts of the lilac scarf obscured by the envelope as smooth uninterrupted surfaces, matching the existing fabric, pearly cream material, soft lighting, and shadows. The torso should have no arm stubs, no paws, no letter edges, no wax seal, no holes, no leftover outlines. Keep every other feature in its original position and proportions: same curled tip, same full head silhouette, same exact plum eyes, smile, cheeks, original lilac scarf shape and knot, same legs, same scale and front camera, same square canvas framing. No redesign, no new props, no expression changes. Genuine transparent background.
